rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296881D00000000}Dad!!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296891D00000000}You're late! What were you doing?

{C:81900100}{C:819582968A1D00000000}Sorry. I was thinking about a few things, and I lost track of time.

{C:81900600}{C:819582968B1D00000000}What am I going to do with you?

{C:819582968C1D00000000}Now, once again. {C:819782830400}{C:819782960000} Akatsuki{C:819782830000}!

{C:81900100}{C:819582968D1D00000000}What is it, Dad?

{C:81900600}{C:819582968E1D00000000}Never mind that. Get serious and answer properly!

{C:81900100}{C:819582968F1D00000000}Y-Yes, sir! (What's gotten into Dad?)

{C:81900600}{C:81958296901D00000000}You understand the mission, don't you?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296921D00000000}Yes, sir.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900200}{C:81958296991D00000000}Hey, are you sure this is okay? Boarding without permission?

{C:81900100}{C:819582969A1D00000000}I'm telling you, it's fine.

{C:819582969B1D00000000}I'll be aboard Norstan too. Nobody's going to notice one extra person.

{C:81900200}{C:819582969C1D00000000}But...

{C:81900100}{C:819582969E1D00000000}You said you wanted a closer look at Norstan, didn't you, Lun?

{C:81900200}{C:819582969F1D00000000}Well... yes, I did, but...

{C:81900100}{C:81958296A11D00000000}I'll be with you. There's nothing to worry about!


{C:81900200}{C:81958296A21D00000000}Yeah, you're right! You'll be with me, after all.

{C:81958296A41D00000000}Come on, then. Let's hurry!




{x00}

{C:81900100}{C:81958296AA1D00000000}The enemy? But the war's over!

{C:81958296AB1D00000000}Sorry, Lun. I have to go. Wait here for me.

{C:81930600}{C:81958296B11D00000000}Where are you going? You can't do it in Impulse 7!

{C:81930300}{C:81958296B31D00000000}Big brother, don't do anything reckless! Listen to Dad!




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296B51D00000000}...And that's the situation. Understood? Hey, are you listening?!

{x00}
rows.notes: Complete native body, source cues, cursor, portrait and continuation margin checked at original Kanji name. Ordinary standard72 story progression.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296B61D00000000}Hm? Oh, yeah. I'm listening.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B71D00000000}I'll say it once more. Your mission is to recapture Norstan, or destroy it.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296B81D00000000}Yeah, I know.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296B91D00000000}As long as you understand.

{C:81958296BA1D00000000}There's still time before departure. Why not take a look around town? You won't be back for a while.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296BB1D00000000}(He's right... Maybe I'll take a look around.)

{C:81958296BC1D00000000}All right, I'll go out for a bit. See you later, Dad.

{C:81900600}{C:81958296BD1D00000000}Yes. Off you go.



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:81958296C51D00000000}(What's Rie up to?)

{C:81900300}{C:81958296C61D00000000}Let's see... I haven't forgotten anything, and I've checked everything... Right! Now I just need to lock up.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296C71D00000000}(Oh, she's locking up. Unlike me, Rie always does things properly.

{C:81958296C81D00000000}Still, I'm proud of my little sister. She earned her doctorate at sixteen!)

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CA1D00000000}Big brother?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296CB1D00000000}Whoa, you startled me! ...What is it, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CC1D00000000}What do you mean, what is it? Why are you standing around in a daze?

{C:81958296CD1D00000000}Aren't you about to leave? Should you really be taking it easy?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296CE1D00000000}Sure I should. Dad ordered me to go and relax before we leave.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296CF1D00000000}Oh... I guess you won't be home for a while.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D01D00000000}Exactly! So, Rie, what do you want me to bring back for you?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296D11D00000000}Honestly, you're not taking this seriously at all!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D21D00000000}Well, I'll bring something back. Norstan, for instance.

{C:81958296D31D00000000}Look after Dad while I'm away, okay?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296D41D00000000}Oh, big brother!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D51D00000000}Hm? What is it?


{C:81900300}{C:81958296D61D00000000}Well, Lu... No, never mind.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296D71D00000000}You're acting weird.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296D81D00000000}I'll see you at the {C:819782830300}airport{C:819782830000} later, okay?


{C:81900100}{C:81958296D91D00000000}The airport...? You're coming to see me off? Aw, you're the best little sister!

{C:81958296DA1D00000000}...Well, I'd better get going too.



{x00}

{C:81900100}{C:81958296DB1D00000000}There's no point standing around wishing I didn't have to leave. ...Let's go.



{x00}

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930200}{C:81958296DE1D00000000}Look, look! Isn't the view beautiful at night?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296DF1D00000000}Yeah, it is.

{C:81930200}{C:81958296E01D00000000}What's wrong? Aren't you having fun with me? Oh, I get it!

{C:81958296E31D00000000}You're thinking something naughty, aren't you?

{C:81930100}{C:81958296E41D00000000}I-I wasn't thinking anything like that!!

{C:81930200}{C:81958296E61D00000000}Ah, you're blushing! You're blushing!



{x00}

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296EA1D00000000}You're back at just the right time.

{C:81958296EB1D00000000}Astante's captain has arrived too. As soon as you get to the bridge, Astante will launch.

{C:81958296EC1D00000000}Your first destination is {C:819782830300}Deon Town{C:819782830000}. You'll take on the rest of your supplies there, then head out into the Cloud Sea.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296ED1D00000000}Got it...

{C:81958296EE1D00000000}Well, Dad, I'm off!

{C:81900600}{C:81958296EF1D00000000}Yes. Off you go!


{x00}
rows.notes: Independent full-row accuracy; parent editorial and final proofreading. All native call/voice/function boundaries preserved. Row44 editorial independently rechecked. Native fit remains pending until exact-build evidence.

rows.en:
{C:81900600}{C:81958296F01D00000000}Pursuing Norstan is... a heavy burden. As your father, I don't want to send you. I could have stopped you.

{C:81958296F11D00000000}But when someone admits their mistake and wants to put it right, who can stop them?

{C:81958296F21D00000000}Go! And come back safely, together with Lun. I'll be waiting...



{x00}
rows.notes: Independent full-row accuracy; parent editorial and final proofreading. All native call/voice/function boundaries preserved. Row44 editorial independently rechecked. Native fit remains pending until exact-build evidence.

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296F91D00000000}Never mind whether it's fun...

{C:81958296FA1D00000000}Where's the captain? Don't tell me they haven't arrived yet.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FB1D00000000}Mm-hm-hmm!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296FD1D00000000}What's with that weird laugh, Rie?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296FE1D00000000}Allow me to introduce the captain! Captain Rie Akatsuki, at your service! Nice to work with you, big brother!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296FF1D00000000}Nice to... What?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296001E00000000}Yep, it's true!

{C:81958296011E00000000}Now that you're here, big brother, we can launch.

{C:81958296021E00000000}First destination, Deon Town!! Astante, launch!!

{C:81900100}{C:81958296031E00000000}Are you serious?!!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296041E00000000}Our destination is Deon Town. That's east of here.


{C:81930000}{C:819782830300}Moving Your Battleship

Use the left stick to control your battleship.

Left and right change your heading. Up moves you forward in the direction you're facing.

A circular radar is displayed at the bottom left of the screen.

This radar shows towns whose ports you've entered before and enemy ships you've discovered.

If your next destination is known, a blue guidance marker will appear.

Travel with the blue marker aligned at the top of the radar to reach your destination easily.

First, follow the blue marker to Deon Town.{C:819782830000}




{x00}

{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296071E00000000}Wait, big brother! I'm coming with you.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296081E00000000}Have you got something to do?

{C:81900300}{C:81958296091E00000000}Checking the deliveries. {C:819782830400}Tail{C:819782830000} should be waiting for us.

{C:81900100}{C:819582960A1E00000000}(Tail... She was Dad's partner during the war, wasn't she?

{C:819582960B1E00000000}People call Dad and Tail heroes, but it's hard to picture them that way.)



{x00}
rows.notes: Independent full-row accuracy; parent editorial and final proofreading. All native call/voice/function boundaries preserved. Row44 editorial independently rechecked. Native fit remains pending until exact-build evidence.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582960C1E00000000}Hello, Tail!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296010000000000}Hello, Rie. You're almost right on time.

{C:81958296020000000000}Here's the list of supplies being brought aboard. Check it for me, will you?

{C:81900300}{C:819582960D1E00000000}Yes!

{C:81900100}{C:819582960E1E00000000}You're handling the supply deliveries too, Tail?

{C:81900900}{C:81958296030000000000}Oh, hello. Thank you for escorting Rie.

{C:81900100}{C:819582960F1E00000000}T-Tail! What are you saying?!

{C:81900900}{C:81958296040000000000}Hee hee... I'm only joking.

{C:81958296050000000000}Anyway, I hear you volunteered to pursue Norstan.

{C:81958296060000000000}You usually hate anything troublesome. What's brought this on?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296101E00000000}Well...

{C:81900900}{C:81958296070000000000}That look tells me there's a reason. All right, I won't pry. But...

{C:81958296080000000000}Following Norstan is certain to mean combat.

{C:81958296090000000000}You two aren't used to fighting. You'll have to be very careful.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296111E00000000}I know, Tail.

{C:81900900}{C:819582960A0000000000}Well, Rie and I need to discuss the deliveries. Excuse us.



{x00}
rows.notes: Independent full-row accuracy; parent editorial and final proofreading. All native call/voice/function boundaries preserved. Row44 editorial independently rechecked. Native fit remains pending until exact-build evidence.

rows.en:
{C:81900A00}{C:81958296121E00000000}Hey, it's been a while. How have you been?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296131E00000000}{C:819782830400}Wind{C:819782830000}! It's good to see you! Where have you been all this time? Dad was worried about you.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296141E00000000}Kyo, worried about me? Get out of here. I've always been a wanderer.

{C:81958296151E00000000}Anyway, enough greetings. I hear you're chasing after Norstan. Be careful out there.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296161E00000000}It'll be my first time really leaving the continent.

{C:81900A00}{C:81958296171E00000000}You're the son of Kyo, the ace pilot. That's not what worries me.

{C:81958296181E00000000}I'm worried there might be other enemies besides whoever stole Norstan.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296191E00000000}Other enemies? Is there some reason you think that?

{C:81900A00}{C:819582961A1E00000000}Right now... all I can call it is a hunch. Just be careful.

{C:819582961B1E00000000}See you around.


{C:81900100}{C:819582961C1E00000000}Wind... He's easy to talk to, isn't he?

{C:819582961D1E00000000}His name's in the history books, but he doesn't act important at all.

{C:819582961E1E00000000}...Well, I'd better get going too.



{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:819582961F1E00000000}Oh, big brother! Sorry to keep you waiting. All the cargo's aboard!


{x00}
rows.notes: Independent full-row accuracy; parent editorial and final proofreading. All native call/voice/function boundaries preserved. Row44 editorial independently rechecked. Native fit remains pending until exact-build evidence.

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296201E00000000}Now we're finally off to the Cloud Sea!

{C:81900900}{C:819582960B0000000000}Yes, yes. Don't rush. There's somewhere else you need to go first.

{C:819582960C0000000000}This time, head for the {C:819782830300}Astante Fortress Ruins{C:819782830000}. A new companion is waiting for you there.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296211E00000000}The Astante Fortress Ruins...? Why would they be in such an old place?

{C:81900900}{C:819582960D0000000000}Professor {C:819782830400}Rondo{C:819782830000} is there doing some research. I think they went along with the professor.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296221E00000000}So our new companion knows Professor Rondo? What are they like?

{C:81900900}{C:819582960E0000000000}Hee hee... You'll find out when you meet. Off you go, now.

{C:81900300}{C:81958296231E00000000}Yes, we're off! Come on, big brother. Let's go!



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:81958296251E00000000}Someone who knows Professor Rondo, huh? What do you think they'll be like, big brother?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296261E00000000}You mean our new companion?

{C:81958296271E00000000}The professor's a hero from the history books, just like Dad and the others.

{C:81958296281E00000000}Thinking about that, I doubt they'll be young...

{C:81958296291E00000000}Maybe they'll be some scrawny, unpleasant type.

{C:81900300}{C:819582962B1E00000000}What? No way!

{C:81900100}{C:819582962C1E00000000}Well, we'll find out when we meet.



{x00}
rows.notes: Independent full-row accuracy; parent editorial and final proofreading. All native call/voice/function boundaries preserved. Row44 editorial independently rechecked. Native fit remains pending until exact-build evidence.

rows.en:
{C:81900300}{C:819582962D1E00000000}Professor Rondo!

{C:81900700}{C:819582962E1E00000000}Oh, Rie. It's been a while. Have you been well?

{C:81900300}{C:819582962F1E00000000}Yes, Professor.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296301E00000000}Hello, Professor!

{C:81900700}{C:81958296311E00000000}What, you're here too? What brings the two of you here? A tour of Astante?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296321E00000000}'What'?! That's harsh, Professor! We came all this way because we heard someone would be joining us.


{C:81930400}{C:81958296331E00000000}He developed the GT and distinguished himself in the Third Claudian War.

{C:81958296341E00000000}And on top of that, Uncle developed the Cloud System! Aren't you being too familiar with such a distinguished man?

{C:81900100}{C:81958296351E00000000}(Who's telling me all about the professor?)




{C:81900400}{C:81958296361E00000000}I'm {C:819782830400}Nelfea{C:819782830000}, {C:819782830400}Nelfea Northrock{C:819782830000}. I'm your guardian, since you two are so unreliable.


{C:81900100}{C:81958296371E00000000}What did you say?!


{C:81900700}{C:81958296381E00000000}That's enough, Nelfea.

{C:81900400}{C:81958296391E00000000}But Uncle, the way he spoke to you...

{C:81900700}{C:819582963A1E00000000}I've told you time and again not to call me Uncle.

{C:819582963B1E00000000}Sorry about that. This is Nelfea. She'll be joining you.

{C:819582963C1E00000000}She's an exceptional pilot, but as you can see, she's still a child. I'm counting on you to look after her.

{C:81900100}{C:819582963D1E00000000}Uh...

{C:81900400}{C:819582963E1E00000000}Oh, Uncle! You always treat me like a child.


{C:819582860100010056000000}
{C:81930700}{C:819582963F1E00000000}Ha ha ha... I'll think about that when you stop calling me Uncle.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296401E00000000}You're so mean, Uncle...




{C:819582860100010000000000}



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81900100}{C:81958296411E00000000}We're finally off. My heart's pounding!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296421E00000000}You're such a child.

{C:81900100}{C:81958296431E00000000}Ghh! Nelfea, you...!

{C:81900400}{C:81958296441E00000000}It's Miss Nelfea to you! Only Uncle gets to call me just Nelfea.


{C:81900300}{C:81958296451E00000000}Oh, enough already! Astante, launching!


{x00}

{C:81900300}{C:81958296461E00000000}(Sigh... Is this voyage really going to be all right with us like this?)



{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930300}{C:81958296491E00000000}Big brother, we've got a message from Dad.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964A1E00000000}From Dad? Put him through.

{C:81930300}{C:819582964C1E00000000}Right.

{C:81930600}{C:819582964D1E00000000}You're finally setting off. There's no telling what lies ahead. Be careful out there.

{C:81930100}{C:819582964E1E00000000}You don't have to keep telling me. I know we're not going on a pleasure trip.

{C:81930600}{C:819582964F1E00000000}Hmm... Fortunately, we've confirmed that other continents are scattered across the Cloud Sea.

{C:81958296501E00000000}If you can, ask the people on those continents for help. You may find someone willing to lend you a hand.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296511E00000000}Got it, Dad. Well, we're off!

{C:81930600}{C:81958296531E00000000}Yes. Off you go!

rows.en:
{C:81930100}{C:819582967A3200000000}Well? Have you found anything out?

{C:81930400}{C:819582967B3200000000}Yes. So far, we know there are six continents besides {C:819782830300}Claudia{C:819782830000}.

{C:819582967C3200000000}The Cloud Stream is too dense around one of them for us to go there.

{C:81930300}{C:819582967D3200000000}You don't know where Norstan went?

{C:81930400}{C:819582967E3200000000}We haven't got a single clue. Don't ask the impossible.

{C:81930100}{C:819582967F3200000000}So all we can do is visit the continents one by one, huh?

{C:81930400}{C:81958296803200000000}That's right. Let's do our best.
